title: 道富环球：韩国超配、台湾低配，中国盈利预期待修复
speaker: Ben Lux

segments.en: In terms of what we see since the sort of the year so we are starting to see institutional investors rebuilding those positions already.
segments.zh: 从年初至今的观察来看，机构投资者已开始重建这些头寸。

segments.en: Taiwan remains to be an underweight story that we see so a lot of that selling really at the sort of the year hasn't really been closed out yet from what we see.
segments.zh: 台湾仍是低配，年初以来的抛售尚未完全平仓。

segments.en: So I think the it's it's less I would say is less attractive compared to sort of the year given how both positions have moved.
segments.zh: 因此，与年初相比，吸引力有所下降，因为两个市场的头寸都已发生变化。

segments.en: But when you compare the large outside US tech story that we're talking about it's there's still a ways to go in terms of how investors can rebuild that Asia tech story.
segments.zh: 但与美国以外的大型科技股相比，投资者重建亚洲科技故事仍有很长的路要走。

segments.en: And just quickly China. Yeah China is a story that we were positive at the beginning and I think it's past tense.
segments.zh: 简单说一下中国。我们年初曾看好中国，但那是过去式了。

segments.en: It's past tense now unfortunately the earning story hasn't lived up to the expectation that we were hoping for.
segments.zh: 遗憾的是，盈利表现未达预期。

segments.en: And really I think a lot of the story for us in China is more focused on the Remembee story being stronger the bond story still being quite.
segments.zh: 我们认为中国市场的故事更多在于人民币走强，债券市场也相对稳健。
